_readme: Sample request bodies for testing through the gateway (http://localhost:8080) or Swagger UI (http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html).
Each entry lists the HTTP call, who may make it (login first with the 'login' payloads) and the JSON body.
Send the returned accessToken as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
Demo user ids (reset on every restart): claimant1=1 (JP), claimant2=2 (SG), officer1=3, officer2=4, manager1=5, claimant3=6 (HK), claimant4=7 (TH), claimant5=8 (IN), claimant6=9 (ID).
A claim's market is taken from the claimant, never sent in the body. 14 demo claims are seeded on start-up.
Suggested order: login -> createClaim -> pickUp/assign -> status moves -> history -> workload.

createHealth.call: POST /api/claims  (claimant1 files for themselves; claimantName and market must match their profile)

body.description: Rear-ended at traffic light, bumper and boot damage

createTravelOnBehalf.call: POST /api/claims  (OFFICER or MANAGER files for a claimant; claimantId is required)

body.description: Cancelled flight to Tokyo, non-refundable hotel booking
Water damage to living room ceiling after pipe burst
Visitor slipped on wet floor at insured premises

assignToOfficer1.call: PUT /api/claims/{id}/assignment  (MANAGER only; officerId must be an OFFICER user id: 3 or 4)

status._note: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status (OFFICER on own or unassigned OPEN claims, MANAGER on any). An officer update on an unassigned OPEN claim picks it up automatically. Flow: OPEN -> ASSIGNED -> UNDER_REVIEW -> APPROVED|REJECTED; APPROVED -> SETTLED -> CLOSED; REJECTED -> CLOSED. While reviewing, staff can ask the claimant for more information (UNDER_REVIEW -> ON_HOLD, remarks required); the claim is then ON HOLD: staff cannot resume, approve, reject or settle it (409), they can only close it, and only the claimant's answer through this same endpoint (see 'provideInfo') puts it back to UNDER_REVIEW. The response is the updated claim plus previousStatus, remarks, changedBy and changedAt.

requestInfo.remarks: Please send the repair invoice and photos of the damage

provideInfo._note: Sent by the CLAIMANT who owns the claim, only while it is ON_HOLD. remarks is the reply and is mandatory; the claim goes back to UNDER_REVIEW and the reply is shown as lastReply.
provideInfo.remarks: Repair invoice INV-77 (JPY 48,000) and photos uploaded to the claims portal

reject.remarks: Incident not covered under policy section 4.2

negativeTests._note: Each of these should fail; the expected status is listed.
negativeTests._noteClaims: The POST /api/claims negatives below are sent as claimant1 (Aiko Tanaka, JP).

requestInfoWithoutRemarks.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status  (OFFICER or MANAGER, claim UNDER_REVIEW) -> 409 Remarks are mandatory when requesting information

requestInfoBeforeReview.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status  (claim still ASSIGNED) -> 409 Cannot move claim from ASSIGNED to ON_HOLD

resumeWhileOnHold.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status  (OFFICER or MANAGER, claim ON_HOLD; same for APPROVED, REJECTED, SETTLED) -> 409 Claim is on hold: waiting for the claimant to provide the requested information

provideInfoWhenNothingRequested.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status  (claimant, claim not ON_HOLD) -> 409 No information has been requested

provideInfoAnyOtherStatus.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status  (claimant asking for APPROVED, CLOSED, ...) -> 403 Claimants can only answer an information request

provideInfoBlankRemarks.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status  (claimant, claim ON_HOLD) -> 409 Remarks are mandatory when answering an information request

createClaimMarketMismatch.call: POST /api/claims  -> 409 Market SG does not match the market of claimant Aiko Tanaka (JP)

createClaimNameMismatch.call: POST /api/claims  -> 409 Name 'Wei Lim' does not match the name of claimant id 1

createClaimantWithoutMarket.call: POST /api/users  (OFFICER or MANAGER) -> 400 Claimants require market and policyNumber

assignToClaimant.call: PUT /api/claims/{id}/assignment  -> 409 User ... is not an officer

rejectWithoutRemarks.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status on an UNDER_REVIEW claim  -> 409 Remarks are mandatory

illegalTransition.call: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status on an OPEN claim  -> 409 Cannot move claim from OPEN to APPROVED

negativeTests.officerNotAssigned: PATCH /api/claims/{id}/status as officer2 on a claim assigned to officer1  -> 403 Claim is not assigned to you
